run_TwoCubesInterpreterTest: run the TwoCubesInterpreterTest suite to test build, destroy, move, and copy commands in a two-cube world
run_FillTest: run the FillTest suite to test filling holes with default or specified block types
run_DestroyEverythingTest: run the DestroyEverythingTest to verify the interpreter destroys all placed blocks in the world
run_DigTest: run the DigTest suite to test single and n-by-n hole digging commands
run_SpawnSheep: run the SpawnSheep test to verify spawning a specified number of sheep mobs
